No code fault: the sweep output was the worker-startup flake that `vitest.config.mts` already documents in its `isolate: false` comment — every one of the 116 files died before any test ran ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'config')" / "Vitest failed to find the runner", 4.29s, 99% of it in environment setup), which is the whole pool collapsing at boot, not an assertion anywhere.

What I did:

- Ran one of the named files narrowed (`npx vitest run test/unified-diff.test.ts`) — 7/7 passed.
- Ran the full `npm test` four consecutive times — 113 passed | 3 skipped (116 files), 1415 tests passed, every time.
- Ran the feature's own test files narrowed (`test/memories.test.ts`, `test/memory-session-context.test.ts`, `test/system-prompt.test.ts`, `test/sdk-session.test.ts`, `test/mode-setup.test.ts`, `test/settings-store.test.ts`, `test/settings-app.test.ts`) — 161 passed — and typechecked the project with `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`, clean.

I changed nothing: there was nothing in the feature's code the output pointed at, and re-cutting the test pool (single worker, fewer forks, or the thread pool — tests here use real temp dirs and jsdom) is the trade the config's comment says was already tried and was worse. The board is left as it was, all three tasks `tested`.
